installAgentPrompt: Emboheko HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) ko computadorape. Emohenda HAX CLI `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global` reheve, upéi emohenda agente ikatupyrykuéra `hax skills install --all` reheve. Ejapo peteĩ tenda `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i` reheve, eñepyrũ `cd my-hax-site && hax serve` reheve, ha emombe'u chéve kundaharape ohechaukáva. Emoñe'ẽ tenda AGENTS.md ha https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw emoambue mboyve mba'eve.
